summary: Adds `tree#contributor`, `dna#reader`, and `tenant#support` (JIT step-up for support staff). All v1 types, relations and conditions are preserved. No removal.
expand_contract_asserts: every type in v1 is present in v2
every relation in v1 is present in v2
every condition in v1 is present in v2
no relation kind is weakened (this/union/tupleToUserset/computedUserset only ADDED, never REPLACED)
v2 backward-compatibility check returns the same allowed/denied answer for every tuple set v1 emitted

new_relations.reason: E4 collaborative tree editing — contributors can add person/relationship suggestions but cannot delete. Distinct from `editor` so audit can attribute diff authors.
E10 DNA namespace — explicit `reader` so the ABAC overlay can wrap with consent + jurisdiction checks. v1 had no relation on `dna` other than `owner`.
R16 §R16.3 — JIT support access is scoped at the tenant boundary; `support` is a time-bounded tuple revoked on issue close.

cases: viewer can view tree#viewer when tenant#viewer tuple exists
revoke `tenant#viewer` for user → viewer can view tree#viewer returns false
re-issue `tenant#viewer` tuple → viewer can view tree#viewer returns true (revoke-first priority, idempotent re-add)
